name: a-log-that-will-not-come-does-not-take-the-check-down
find:
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  a log is never worth failing the check for
        return ""
replace:
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  a log is never worth failing the check for
        raise
breaks: one job's log failing to download takes the whole duration report down, so a transient API wobble costs every job's reading rather than one job's normalisation (#1039, L73)
